scenes.title: Megumi’s request — trailer taster
scenes.summary: In the official Season 1 trailer, Megumi explains her wish to be her true self and asks to appear in adult videos. This taster contains her request alone, without an invented reply.
scenes.location: Trailer montage: Megumi’s request at a film workplace

coverage.reason: One short request from Netflix Japan’s official Season 1 trailer, retained as an explicitly partial Japanese transcript. The s01e01 folder is the first catalogue lesson slot; it does not certify source Episode 1 or the full trailer.
